programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道長所在的村落中有一座殘舊的教堂，修女瑪利亞前往重開教堂，剛巧村裡無水可用，村長找一眉道長勘察地理來尋找問題的源頭，發現是村中突然多出大量蝙蝠，並棲身於此教堂裡

programme.title: 至尊三十六計之偷天換日
programme.desc: 錢文迪，鐘楚雄，劉耀祖，陳聰明四人聚集在一起賭博，文迪利用女友莉莉和搭檔阿智（金手指）兩位發牌員的協助靠出千贏了600多萬，其中劉耀祖輸的最多達400萬事後三-人在酒吧碰到帶著一眾兄弟的鐘楚雄，被發覺欺騙了他，於是雙方掀起了打鬥，鐘楚雄受傷三人的事亦被劉耀祖發現，劉耀祖威脅文迪要他進監獄為劉辦一件事：魯賓孫原來為他工-作，不料偷了他的三億債券，文迪只要能設法從魯賓孫口中得知債券的下落，事成後就可以給他一千萬作為報酬於是莉莉向法庭告文迪強姦她，結果因證據不足未被法官採納，文迪-因藐視法庭和用鞋襲擊法官的罪名而被判入獄一年文迪入獄後，為了順利接觸魯賓孫和免受別人的欺負，於是他願意出錢收買到了囚犯基哥，雄哥和瘋標為首的一些獄友的照顧...

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 一個鄉村里，遠隔幾十里路都沒有人，只住著兩戶人家，一位和尚，一位道士，和尚名叫一休大師，還有個女徒弟叫菁菁，道士名叫四目道長，還有個男徒弟叫家樂家樂一直深深喜歡菁菁，兩人經常互相逗笑和調情他們的師傅則是因為門戶之見和民族內訌性格而經常互相鬥法，最後雙方都兩敗俱傷

programme.desc: 一般香港小市民，武德輝與厲遲（劉德華與陳百祥飾）在一家廣告公司任職，受盡凌辱一次因公幹赴內地，兩人決定走私出土古物，遭解放軍追捕而墜入山崖，誤入一處元朝秘室古墓，竟發現古代如來神掌秘笈和冷藏兩百年的元朝雲蘿公主（王祖賢飾）及侍婢小蠻，且誤打誤撞釋放了兩百年前天下第一邪派高手天殘（元華飾）．．．

programme.desc: 1949年，潮州人雷洛，為了生計，投考香港警察訓練學校，在面試時他不太識字，甚至連報紙上徐蚌會戰的蚌與攻陷的陷都念不出來，但還是順利錄取了，於黃竹坑受訓半年後結訓，結訓時警校教官居然告訴他們，不一定要自命清高，要因時達變，雷洛對於這種同流合汙的貪腐思想相當不滿

programme.title: 拆彈專家2
programme.desc: 香港發生連環爆炸案，令全城人心惶惶前拆彈專家潘乘風（劉德華飾）昏迷於案發現場，被警方列為頭號嫌疑犯，懷疑他跟邪惡組織復生會有密切聯繫甦醒後的潘乘風，面對警方施壓式的盤問和牢獄之災，決定逃走親自查明真相在孤立無援的絕路上，潘乘風找他的戰友拆彈專家董卓文（劉青雲飾）協助，但由於二人陷入黑白不明的矛盾狀況，董卓文必須在公私之間作出抉擇基於出生入死的友情，他決定向摯友伸出援手同時，潘乘風前女友龐玲（倪妮飾），現為反恐特勤隊總督察，急於查出連環爆炸案的幕後黑手，以確保市民安全，她說服潘乘風接觸復生會，追查這神秘組織的下一步恐襲計劃，以證明他的清白然而，令潘乘風最意想不到的, 竟是揭破真相就如拆除炸彈般危險艱鉅，在爭分奪秒中隨時送命

programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.title: 黃色復仇草
programme.desc: 講述一個曾經活潑明朗的女生背負冤屈失去一切漸漸走上復仇之路的故事

programme.title: 知否知否應是綠肥紅瘦
programme.desc: 盛家六姑娘明蘭從小聰穎貌美，卻遭遇嫡母不慈，姐妹難纏，父親不重視，生母被害去世的困境她在萬般打壓之下依然自立自強，終歷盡艱難為母報仇這一過程中，明蘭結識了寧遠侯府二公子顧廷燁他見過明蘭軟糯表皮下的聰慧銳利，也見過她剛強性格中的脆弱孤單，對她早已傾心...

programme.title: 初次為了愛
programme.desc: 單親媽媽李智安獨自扶養女兒長大，當醫學生女兒的人生出現轉折，母女來到海邊小鎮展開新生活命運讓她與初戀柳正碩重逢，塵封多年的感情再次萌芽，而兩人的下一代也悄悄譜出青春戀曲一段關於親情初戀與第二人生的療癒故事，就此展開．．．

programme.title: 錦衣之下
programme.desc: 講述的是講述了奸臣當道的明朝嘉靖末年，錦衣衛陸繹奉命調查揚州修河款失蹤案，得到六扇門女捕快袁今夏協助，二人結為甜蜜冤家，卻意外捲入重重陰謀的故事

programme.title: 木槿花開

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記

programme.title: 人生倒數第二次戀愛3
programme.desc: 45歲單身的電視台戲劇製作人吉野千明（小泉今日子 飾），在因緣際會下，決定隻身移居鎌倉古民家展開新生活此時，她遇見了性格保守獨自扶養女兒的50歲公務員鄰居長倉和平（中井貴一 飾），以及其妹妹典子（飯島直子 飾）雙胞胎姊弟万里子（內田有紀 飾）和真平（?口憲二 飾）當急躁的都會女強人碰上沉穩的在地公務員，性格迥異的兩人將展開怎樣的大人式戀愛？

programme.title: 學校警察
programme.desc: 警視廳搜?一課的刑警?田隆平（藤原龍也 飾），自願成為日本首位派駐國中的校園警察面對校園內的毒品偷拍網路糾紛及職場霸凌，?田抱持我會保護你們，但也絕不寬貸的冷酷作風他那觸法即逮捕的強硬手段，雖與校內老師淺村涼子（真木陽子 飾）頻起衝突，卻也狠狠揭開了校園黑暗面，讓陷入迷惘的學生與老師們開始產生轉變

programme.title: 深度日本
programme.desc: 你知道UNIQLO是怎麼成功的嗎？大家愛去的唐吉訶德如何擴大經營？安藤忠雄大師用建築風靡世界！近年暴紅的WORKMAN工作服Im donut?甜甜圈，他們如何異軍突起？緯來獨家引進知識型日綜深度日本，讓你知道的就是比別人多！

programme.title: 日本我來了

programme.title: 大宋少年志:40
programme.desc: 慶曆年間，北宋貌似繁華安定的景象下暗潮洶湧，周邊各個割據政權的細作潛伏於汴京城內，窺探大宋軍政祕事北宋為免除戰事，維護各民族間的和平與穩定，借祕閣之名，培訓少年暗探經過嚴密的選拔和審查，詭詐聰慧的元仲辛美貌機敏的趙簡從不殺生的小景絕不說謊的王寬不愛交流的薛映喜歡美女的韋衙內六位少年，因為種種原因，或情願或被迫，組成了祕閣第七齋

programme.title: 老狐狸
programme.desc: 故事發生在1989年全民皆股的年代，小男孩廖界與父親廖泰來相依為命，他們相信人性本善，沒發現世界正在改變股市飆漲物價翻倍，有人一夕暴富，有人意識到現實殘酷；單純老實的廖界父子屬於後者不料，他們碰上了聰明狡猾的老狐狸，命運道路可能截然不同財富與良心兩條岔路，該怎麼選？

programme.title: 飆風老爹
programme.desc: 徐大偉是個技術高超的潛水教練，擇善固執讓他頗受業界好評，海派豪爽的個性，更是朋友的好酒友，但另一方面個性偏執頑固，一板一眼的個性，讓自己跟女兒若雲的關係一直不是處的很好，對若雲來說，父親就是個不負責任的糟老頭，在妻子過世後，兩人的關係更為惡劣 若雲也在高中畢業後，與男友仁勇負氣私奔到台北，十八年來，兩父女誰也不跟誰聯絡，始終僵在那裏，其實都在期待著誰先妥協，十八年後，仁勇在國外出差受傷，若雲緊急出國照顧，只好委託好友芳慧，帶著三個孩子回到墾丁讓大偉照顧，這舉動更讓大偉感到厭惡，十八年來無聲無息，突然就多了三個孫子，還要照顧他們，一向我行我素的大偉，一口氣多了三個家人，這讓他不知道該喜還是該怒！在一次與不良飆車族的衝突下，大家才發現，原來大偉就是傳說中的飆風騎士..

programme.title: 棟仁的時光:10
programme.desc: 一個吻可以改寫甚麼？一個媽媽的吻別，令閏秒出生就夭折的曾棟仁奇蹟地活下來一個急救之吻，救護員程敏琦令棟仁得以續命，讓他知道自己有偷時間續命的能力，也讓敏琦昏睡兩日，錯過了自己的婚禮，未婚夫還離奇失蹤！一個借來的吻，同時感應到對方的想法或感受，令棟仁攀上事業高峰，並足以協助身邊人改寫命運：改善單親爸爸張潮岸的父女關係激發廢青羅瑞楠的鬥志一個最後續命之吻，也是愛人敏琦奪命之吻，棟仁會如何抉擇？

programme.title: 踩過界2:12
programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

programme.title: 平安谷之詭谷傳說:18
programme.desc: 縱已踏入民初時代，地處一隅的平安谷仍由男權主導，女人地位卑微村長陸金谷思想守舊，與海外歸來的兒子陸水豐，及自小受西方教育的媳婦羅桂思產生不少矛盾金谷一妻三妾，宋鳴鳳顧曼儀田初一等三妾背後各有辛酸遭遇陸家表面風平浪靜，其實金谷有病加上鳴鳳之女被擄等神秘事件接連發生桂思對村中男女不平等感到失望，決要幫助受欺壓的婦女此時，有一股勢力暗中策劃各項反男權行動，令村中的男女角力一發不可收拾！

programme.title: 愛回家之開心速遞:2410
programme.desc: 世代交替，新一代對舊一代嗤之以鼻，總覺得被別人阻礙著他們的未來同樣地，年長一輩亦擁抱過往成功的經驗，總認為自己永遠是對的故事的軸心家庭熊家，正是世代之爭的投射輕鬆的情節除了呈現社會面貌，也用愛和歡笑拉近兩代之間的距離，讓年輕一輩懂得欣賞昔日的美好，舊一代也能聆聽新世代的聲音

programme.title: 東坡家事:26
programme.desc: 一代大文豪蘇東坡（歐陽震華飾），才華洋溢，生性豁達，對亡妻王弗情深義重這份深情，讓寄居於蘇府的王弗堂妹王閏之（萬綺雯飾）對東坡暗生情愫，並多番暗示，惜東坡一直迴避其心意一次，東坡和閏之意外惹怒壽安郡主（李亞男飾），閏之為保東坡仕途，答應郡主下嫁鼓莊公子韓元不知情的東坡以為閏之終於想通，送她出嫁，豈料卻發現韓家暗地裡經營假官交子（偽鈔）勾當，韓太君脅持蘇家眾人，逼閏之跟韓元成親，幸關鍵時刻得秦少游（王浩信飾）相救，少游卻失蹤

programme.desc: 科技罪案組高級督察司徒忠督察蕭美婷在工作上亦師亦友，屢破各種電話網絡科技騙案；司徒忠在偵查一宗網上情緣案件的過程中，重遇前度女友張慧，碰巧她與丈夫沈子浩關係破裂，司徒忠與張慧愛火得以重燃與此同時，倫敦金騙案鬧得滿城風雨，而子浩與張慧亦牽連其中，危機四伏......

programme.title: 平安谷之詭谷傳說:19
programme.desc: 縱已踏入民初時代，地處一隅的平安谷仍由男權主導，女人地位卑微村長陸金谷思想守舊，與海外歸來的兒子陸水豐，及自小受西方教育的媳婦羅桂思產生不少矛盾金谷一妻三妾，宋鳴鳳顧曼儀田初一等三妾背後各有辛酸遭遇陸家表面風平浪靜，其實金谷有病加上鳴鳳之女被擄等神秘事件接連發生桂思對村中男女不平等感到失望，決要幫助受欺壓的婦女此時，有一股勢力暗中策劃各項反男權行動，令村中的男女角力一發不可收拾！

programme.title: 東坡家事:26
programme.desc: 一代大文豪蘇東坡（歐陽震華飾），才華洋溢，生性豁達，對亡妻王弗情深義重這份深情，讓寄居於蘇府的王弗堂妹王閏之（萬綺雯飾）對東坡暗生情愫，並多番暗示，惜東坡一直迴避其心意一次，東坡和閏之意外惹怒壽安郡主（李亞男飾），閏之為保東坡仕途，答應郡主下嫁鼓莊公子韓元不知情的東坡以為閏之終於想通，送她出嫁，豈料卻發現韓家暗地裡經營假官交子（偽鈔）勾當，韓太君脅持蘇家眾人，逼閏之跟韓元成親，幸關鍵時刻得秦少游（王浩信飾）相救，少游卻失蹤

programme.desc: 世代交替，新一代對舊一代嗤之以鼻，總覺得被別人阻礙著他們的未來同樣地，年長一輩亦擁抱過往成功的經驗，總認為自己永遠是對的故事的軸心家庭熊家，正是世代之爭的投射輕鬆的情節除了呈現社會面貌，也用愛和歡笑拉近兩代之間的距離，讓年輕一輩懂得欣賞昔日的美好，舊一代也能聆聽新世代的聲音

programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: Deadly Mission Shark S1 Ep03 (致命任务鱼S1 Ep03)
programme.desc: Steve Backshall is taking ten novice divers on one Deadly mission - to dive with sharks in Bimini, the shark capital of the world, with the ultimate goal being to qualify as scuba divers. (史蒂夫·贝克沙尔将带10名初学者潜水员去一个致命任务 - - 潜水与鱼在比米尼,鱼世界首都,最终目标是成为潜水员.)

programme.title: Deadly Mission Shark S1 Ep04 (致命任务鱼S1 Ep04)
programme.desc: Some of the team explores the mangroves, which are essential for the survival of some sharks. While there, they come face to face with baby lemon sharks. (部分研究人员正在探索一些鱼生存至关重要的树.)

programme.title: Robson Greens Weekend Escapes S4 Ep07 ((Robson Greens Weekend 逃出生天s S4 Ep07))
programme.desc: Actor Mark Benton joins Robson on a Scottish road trip to East Lothian. Robson introduces Mark to bird watching, cookery and highland games. The pair stay in a double-decker bus. (演员马克·宾顿加入罗布森在苏格兰东洛蒂安的路上旅行.罗布森介绍了马克的鸟类观看,和高地游戏.这对夫妇住在双层公交车里.)

programme.title: Robson Greens Weekend Escapes S4 Ep08 ((Robson Greens Weekend 逃出生天s S4 Ep08))
programme.desc: Robson joins up with Sheli McCoy, aka Gladiator Sabre, to explore Fife. They take a paddleboard tour of the coast, stay on a farm overnight and make a boat trip to the Isle of May. (罗布森和谢利·麦科伊 (Sheli McCoy) 一起探索菲夫,他们乘坐板游览海岸,在农场上过夜,然后乘船前往梅岛.)

programme.title: Spectacular Earth S1 Ep04 (壮观的地球S1 Ep04)

programme.desc: Nostalgia aims to represent Chinese traditional culture by revealing life in villages in the way of story-telling. In this show, the audience can enjoy the natural and cultural backgrounds. (怀念是以讲故事的方式展示中国传统文化,以揭示村庄的生活.)

programme.title: Around China ((电影眼漫游中国))
programme.desc: Enter a world where the true essence of China blossoms and you will begin to understand how this great nation has evolved. (进入一个中国真正的世界,你会开始理解这个伟大的国家是如何发展的.)

programme.title: Across the Strait ((海峡两岸（中央电视台涉台时事新闻评论栏目）))
programme.desc: This program details the China Governments policy of one country. (报告中详细介绍了中国政府对一个国家的政策.)

programme.title: Asia Today ((中文))
programme.desc: Asia Today highlights the latest news and social developments across Asia. Correspondents report on the regions top stories while analysts bring Asian perspective to topical and developing issues. (亚洲今日强调亚洲各地最新新闻和社会发展.记者报告有关地区的头条新闻,而分析师将亚洲视角带入当前和发展问题.)

programme.title: China News ((豆瓣))
programme.desc: Catch the latest news and social changes that are moving China and the world. (获取最新的新闻和社会变化,)

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: Three swordsmens search for the murderous Bat Without Wings brings to light a plethora of criminal individuals and twists in the tale.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: When a bag of jewels falls from the sky, thats just the start of Ah Nius misadventures involving a brothel, a disastrous wedding night and the cops!

programme.title: Disciples of Shaolin
programme.desc: One of Chang Chehs finest films, this saga stars Alexander Fu Sheng in his greatest martial arts role as a penniless country boy who fights his way to riches.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Attracted by a sensual rain dance performed by three tribeswomen, three snake siblings set in motion a tale of romance, lust and tragedy.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: This intriguing action flick blends westerns and detective films in its martial arts mainline, depicting a tale of vigilante justice versus the law.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins ((阿牛出獄記))
programme.desc: After Ah Niu gets out of jail, he gets involved again with his crooked Uncle Chou and caught in other rackets and silly situations. (子从监狱出来后,他又和子在一起,)

programme.title: Legend of the Bat ((罗小黑战记))
programme.desc: Director Chor Yuen reunites with novelist, Gu Long, and superstar, Ti Lung, in this exciting sequel to Clans of Intrigue. (导演Chor Yuen与小说家,古龙和超级明星,蒂隆,在这个令人兴奋的后续剧中重新相遇.)

programme.title: The Story of Sue San ((玉堂春))
programme.desc: This compelling Shaw Brothers Huangmei Opera depicts the romance of star-crossed lovers the son of a respected government official and a famed prostitute. (这部令人信服的肖兄弟黄梅歌剧描述了星际爱情者之间的浪漫,)

programme.title: Life Gamble ((生死门))
programme.desc: Legendary director Chang Cheh teams Alexander Fu Sheng and Venoms Lo Meng and Kuo Chue in an exciting tale of a kung fu blacksmith. (传奇导演长切团队亚历山大福雪格和毒品洛孟和郭楚在一个激动人心的故事中)

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu Lan ((花木兰))
programme.desc: A young woman joins the army in place of her old, ailing father and only when she returns home is the truth revealed. (一个年轻女子加入军队,代替她老的父亲, 病患,)

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2 ((射雕英雄传续集))
programme.desc: In this Brave Archer sequel, Kuo Tsings Alexander Fu Sheng love for Huang Yung Niu Niu is challenged by Ouyang Fung. (在这部勇敢的弓箭手续集中,郭清斯亚历山大福盛对黄永纽纽纽的爱情被乌阳丰挑战.)

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy ((遗产五亿元))
programme.desc: Three women and three men beguile, blackmail, bicker and backstab each other all the way to a shocking surprise ending. (三个女人和三个男人欺骗,勒索,架,刺彼此,)

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web ((盘丝洞))
programme.desc: Seven seductive Spiders lie in wait for our faithful heroes in the third installment of the Shaw Brothers adaptation of Journey to the West. (七个诱人蜘蛛在"旅程到西方"的肖兄弟改编的第三部份中等待我们的忠诚英雄.)

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3 ((射雕英雄传第三集))
programme.desc: Kuo Tsings Alexander Fu Sheng adventures continue in Part 3 of this series of film adaptations of The Eagle Shooting Heroes. (库斯亚历山大福的冒险继续在这个系列电影改编的第三部分.)

programme.title: The Younger Generation ((年青的一代))
programme.desc: After a young mother and her husband die, one child is sold into prostitution to feed the other four. (一个年轻的母亲和丈夫死后,一个孩子被卖给妓女,)

programme.title: The Villains ((十字追杀令3))
programme.desc: When the younger of two brothers becomes a villain, tragedy lurks when his elder brother makes it his mission to take him down. (两个兄弟的年轻人变成了恶棍,)

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl ((山歌恋))
programme.desc: This heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers tells the tale of a beautiful shepherdess, whose own problems drag her into a love triangle. (这部来自Shaw兄弟的1963年的令人心情的音乐剧讲述了一个美丽的牧妇的故事,)

programme.title: Purple Darts ((紫金镖))
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge against the 4 outlaws who murdered her parents when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman to kill them. (一个女孩发誓要报复4名杀害她的父母的罪犯,)

programme.title: Mr Funny Bone ((老夫子))
programme.desc: Whenever Mr. Funny Bone travels about with his sidekick Big Potato, he often gets involved in all manner of charming comic mishaps. (哥先生和他的助手大一起旅行时,他经常卷入各种迷人的漫画意外.)

programme.title: Killer Clans ((流星蝴蝶剑))
programme.desc: This abourer and complex adaptation of a popular wuxia novel contains conspiracies, stratagems, and sword fights aplenty. (这部流行的武士小说的繁而复杂改编包含了阴谋,策略和剑斗争.)

programme.title: Dead End ((归去))
programme.desc: Directed by Chang Cheh and starring Ti Lung in his first main role, this drama depicts how two lovers contend with family opposition and an unjust accusation. (导演:张切,主演:蒂隆,这部剧中,两个爱人如何应对家庭反对和不公正的指控.)

programme.title: Four Riders ((四骑士))
programme.desc: Set in Seoul right after the Korean War, a kung-fu master, combat instructor, explosives expert and missiles specialist take on a drug smuggling ring. (在韩国战争结束后,在首尔,一名功夫师,战斗教练,爆炸物专家和导弹专家,)

programme.title: Puppy Love ((小狗之爱))
programme.desc: Playfulness abounds and innocence is lost in this tale of two naughty females who grow up and discover boys together. (两个不雅的女人在一起长大,发现男孩的故事中,充满了玩意,)

programme.title: The King Boxer ((铁拳))
programme.desc: This drama captures the legend of a young boxer who battles the odds to become the ultimate fighter in a tournament against his greatest rivals. (这部戏剧捕捉了一个年轻拳击手的传说,)

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan ((爱奴))
programme.desc: This 1972 cult classic stars Lily Ho in her most audacious role as a mysterious courtesan caught in a web of sex and murder with her powerful madam. (这部1972年的邪教经典, 饰演Lily Ho,她扮演着一个神秘的妓女, 被她强大的夫人入了性和谋杀的网络.)

programme.title: The Happy Trio ((双星伴月))
programme.desc: Following the lives of three downtrodden, but resilient outcasts, John Lo Mars gritty social drama paints a sense of realism rarely seen in Hong Kong movies. (约翰·洛·马斯 (John Lo Mars) 讲述了三位受压迫但坚强的流离失所者的生活.)

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional racer falls into despair after causing his brothers death. He meets Dr. Hui becomes an ambulance driver. Meanwhile, his friends uncover the truth behind his brothers accident.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad tempered and lives alone. He decides to end his life as he feels hopeless but is saved by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: All U Need is Love
programme.desc: When a luxury hotel in Hong Kong suddenly becomes a Coronavirus superspreader, guests the staff are faced with a 14-day trial they may not survive.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A family running a Chinese dessert shop faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. This heartfelt journey reveals the strength of family bonds, sacrifices, and resilience.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop (禁止城市警察)
programme.desc: A huge hit in the HK, this typical Stephen Chow movie combines history, science fiction, martial arts comedy elements makes it a fun watch. (这部典型的史蒂芬·乔电影在香港取得了巨大成功. 结合历史,科幻,武术喜剧元素,)

programme.title: Turns We Take ((杨龙澄))
programme.desc: A traffic accident that resulted in a taxi driver being blinded inexplicably connects a group of unrelated people together, including blind masseurs from a massage center, a young man a couple. (由于交通事故导致出租车司机失明, 无人联系的群体, 包括一个按摩中心的盲人按摩师,)

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In ((九龙城寨之围城))
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the dangerous Kowloon Walled City, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom while becoming one of the Citys protectors. (年轻的陈洛克·库恩意外地遇到了危险的科隆城墙,随后在混乱中找到目的,并获得智慧,成为城市的保护者之一.)

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins ((十月围城))
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty. (获8项HKFA奖,其中包括全明星演员,这部电影描绘了一支精英团队在香港守卫孙森博士,)

programme.title: Cliff Walkers (悬崖步行者)
programme.desc: Zhang Yi Mous first spy thriller follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret mission in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo - only to be sold out by a traitor. (张鼠的第一部间惊片讲述了共产党四名特工在日本子邦的秘密任务中出发,)

programme.title: Its a Wonderful Life (这是一段美妙的生活)
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his sons failed marriage and Kwais dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto. (泰,一个富人不满意他的儿子失败的婚姻,克瓦伊梦想成为漫画家.他希望他的女儿,安,但她从法国返回与野蛮的鲁伯托.)

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple 2: Before We Forget (果小孩2:我们忘记之前)
programme.desc: Sarah and her mother return to Malaysia to spend time with her retired grandfather. When they discover his early signs of dementia, they face the challenges together while cherishing their moments. (萨拉和她的母亲回到马来西亚,和她退休的祖父在一起.)

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain ((造云的山))
programme.desc: As a decade-long tunnel project reaches completion, an earthquake strikes, forcing a retired soldier his son to stop the disasters at the source, or risk the community - and the tunnel. (十年长的道工程完成后,地震发生,)

programme.title: Inner Senses ((异度空间))
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan seeks help from psychiatrist Dr Jim. As she heals, Jim is haunted by the same disturbances when his suppressed memories resurface. (随着她愈合,吉姆也被那些被压抑的记忆重新浮现时的疾病困扰.)

programme.title: Everything Under Control ((超神经械劫案下))
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, Jelly steals the loot and flees, with his other cohorts hot on his heel. They stumble onto a remote village with strange villagers and mysterious eerie occurrences. (在钻石抢劫期间,杰利偷走了物品,他和其他队友们在他的脚上.)

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths ((神探大战))
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths. Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real Chosen Sleuth instead of a lunatic. (香港被一系列冷血谋杀事件所震撼,受害者是未解决案件的逃跑嫌疑人.这群杀手自称是选中的杀手.前高级侦探李誓言将残忍的杀手绳之以法,证明自己是真正的选中的杀手,而不是疯子.)

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Extended version (完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结完结)
programme.desc: In this Hong Kong comedy, three Chang brothers learn love needs care, not haste or selfishness. This extended cut adds a shootout scene missing from the 2016 Lunar New Year release (在香港的这部喜剧中,三兄弟学会了爱需要关怀,而不是急于或自私.)

programme.title: We are Family (我们是家庭)
programme.desc: Rent-a-Family offers relatives for rent and in the process, the trio rendering such services discover the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way. (租一家人提供租的亲属, 在此过程中, 提供这些服务的三人发现了家庭关系的复杂性,)

programme.title: Stuntman ((特技替身演员))
programme.desc: A washed-up stunt director is struggling to find his way in the changing film industry. He risks everything to make a comeback, while striving to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter. (一位坏的作导演在不断变化的电影界中努力找到自己的路径.他冒着一切的风险来恢复,同时努力修复与他疏远的女儿的关系.)

programme.title: Good Game ((高手过招))
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports teamall for a HK500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot. (一位绝望的互联网咖啡馆老板招募了他的女儿,一个流的动作明星和一个失败的职业游戏玩家,)

programme.title: The Wig (子)
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a successful lawyer. During an investigation into a court case, he meets a girl who triggers his memories of a rainy night, revealing a long-hidden secret from 20 years ago... (孟是一位成功的律师,在调查法庭案件中,他遇到了一个女孩,)

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert ((Blades of the 银河护卫队: Wind Rises in the Desert))
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Changan, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world. (逃亡的奖励猎人道马护送了最被寻求的逃犯穿越沙漠到根,)

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon ((但愿人长久))
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty and their fathers drug addiction. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones. (和她的妹妹面临身份危机,贫困和他们的父亲的毒品成.)

programme.title: Ready or Knot ((不日成婚))
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the next step.? (一对夫妇在婚礼上第一次见面,已经在一起五年,从不同的角度来看,他们质疑婚姻的立场.)

programme.title: Johor Military Force (约翰霍尔军事部队)
programme.desc: The Royal Johor Military Force is tasked with guarding the state of Johor and its king. Believed to be Malaysias oldest and only state army, it has played pivotal roles in many historical events. (马来西亚的皇家约霍尔军力负责保护约霍尔州及其国王.据信是马来西亚最古老的唯一的州军队,它在许多历史事件中起到了关键作用.)

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bats knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Taos real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rongs hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brothers Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her fathers towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her fathers debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Casino Tycoon. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yips boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victims sister takes revenge by spiking the rapists drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Mans matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Ministers daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxis concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his fathers land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiaos spirit is revived to take revenge when the dolls eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kongs brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhangs custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witchbut can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: 我爱你! Love Never Ends

programme.title: 不说话的爱 MuMu

programme.title: 误判 Prosecutor, The

programme.title: 不是你不爱你 Love at First Lie
programme.desc: 那年暑假，性格开朗善良的平凡少女阿宝偶遇不务正业的富家子家伟为报复父亲再婚，家伟聘用阿宝及其好友等人捣乱婚礼，促成他与阿宝认识并开始交往两人情投意合，尝尽热恋甜蜜，岂料命运却为这段爱情安排了急转直下的暗涌.

programme.title: 长安的荔枝 The Lychee Road

programme.title: 秘密访客 Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: 一场惨烈的校车车祸，导致几乎全部学童丧生司机拼命救回一名男孩，却令自己失去部分记忆男孩的父亲为答救命之恩，把司机带到自家地下室里与他们共同生活司机渐渐发现这家人的行为诡秘，众人的异常更似乎与那场车祸有关.

programme.title: 唐探1900 Detective Chinatown 1900

programme.title: 猛鬼3宝 Let It Ghost

programme.title: 世间有她 Hero
programme.desc: 2020年新冠疫情来袭，三位女性在前景不明朗的困境中，各自与朋友和家人找寻出路从家里的难题到感情关系的挣扎，还有工作上的斗争，这三位女性都坚强地在困境中找寻出路.

programme.title: 暗杀风暴 Death Notice
programme.desc: 在某城市，连环杀人案的凶手发放死亡通知单预告所有人，将在何时以何罪向何人执行死刑即使收到通知单的人报案，得到警方的贴身保护，凶手照样能突破重围，手刃受刑人警方为此成立了特别项目小组，却同时揭发背后还隐藏着更大的阴谋.

programme.title: 饭戏攻心2 Table for Six 2
programme.desc: 这是饭戏攻心的续集，讲述二哥和三哥在大哥离家之际，计划要结婚最后，他们的婚宴成为一个混乱的战场，婚宴升级为家族斗兽场，造成一场喜上加喜的饭戏！.

programme.title: 非诚勿扰III If You are the One III
programme.desc: 2031年，秦奋退休后独自住在小岛上，而他的妻子笑笑却出国工作10年没回来过秦奋非常挂念笑笑，于是其好友制造了一个与笑笑长得一模一样的智慧机械人与他为伴当秦奋与机械人一起相处融洽时，笑笑却突然回家此刻秦奋要从两个笑笑中决定谁去谁留.

programme.desc: 年轻貌美的企业家乔文娜被控为一宗密室杀人案的疑凶，而死者正是她的情夫乔文娜找来一名警察协助她洗脱罪名，调查期间他们揭发另一牵涉乔文娜和她情夫的凶杀案，真相逐渐浮出水面.

programme.title: 悟空传 Wu Kong
programme.desc: 在孙悟空未成为齐天大圣前，天庭蓄意毁掉花果山，图以掌控众生命运，悟空在屠杀中得以残存，决心余生要跟天庭对抗到底悟空在天庭遇到一生不能爱却深深爱上的阿紫和一生最强的宿敌杨戬，各人都不甘命运的摆布，却没想到反抗只会带来更大的浩劫他们所做的一切，究竟是不知天高地厚的轻狂，还是无惧宿命抗战到底的热血！.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Furious Fun

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S1 - Game Show

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Pirates

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S2 - Clover The Moss

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - King Pickles

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Role Reversal

programme.desc: After finding a majestic horse in the wild, Lucky and the girls set out to solve the mystery of where she came from -- and where she truly belongs.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Punishment and Torcher
programme.desc: While punished, Tom must sneak out to rescue the Riders from Buzzsaw.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Welcome to the Wonderful World of Dragons

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Formula for Menace: A Dekker Moonboots Mystery
programme.desc: When Baby Corp babies start aging, panic hits the office and the babies set out to find out if someone has been tainting the formula

programme.desc: The annual baby pageant approaches, but Stacis plan to win may have a negative effect

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - The Constipation Situation
programme.desc: Boss Baby struggles to take a sick day even though a mysterious baby cry is wreaking havoc on the neighborhood baby-love

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Senseless Torment Of The Space
programme.desc: Inspired by their favorite TV show, George and Harold along with Principal Krupp blast off to outer space, where an angry toilet awaits.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Abandoned Artifact of the Absen
programme.desc: After George and Harold learn the truth about their mission, Dupe Licitous enlists the entire crew in a quest to repair a rogue satellite.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Hazardous Hysteria of the Hangr
programme.desc: Everybody on the spaceship has been cryogenically frozen for three months everyone, that is, except Krupp, whos wide awake and happily in charge.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Shell Shocked Part 2

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Sandbusted

programme.title: Fast Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Key To The Strip

programme.title: Fast Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Escape from L.A.

programme.title: Fast Furious: Spy Racers S1 - That Sinking Feeling

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - One Last Job

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Doom and Groom

programme.title: 现在很美丽 Its Beautiful Now
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备 三兄弟谁先结婚？.

programme.title: 他从火光中走来 Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进.

Episode 1 from Dolphins Arena in Nagoya, Japan features Takarafuji, Ichinojo, Shimanoumi and Kiribayama.

programme.title: Las Vegas Finals: Part 6
programme.desc: In the Season 7 finale, contestants tackle the final three stages of the Mount Midoriyama course in Las Vegas. Stage 2 features a new obstacle, Roulette Row and Stage 3 has the new Psycho Chain and Area 51 obstacles.

programme.title: FS MMA Carina Damm vs. Molly Helsel
programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! Female fighter Carina Barbie Damm battles all three rounds against Molly The Maulinator Helsel in Costa Rica.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights Paul Williams vs. Sergio Martinez

programme.title: World Team Championships
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best judo of the World Team Championships from Budapest, where we will see history made as its the first time a new mixed gender team format will be seen.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Danny Garcia vs. Erik Morales
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Danny Garcia looking to win the WBC super lightweight championship when he squares off with Erik Morales, but Garcia must battle back after suffering a nose injury early on. Also on the card, former world champions Hector Camacho and Adonis Stevenson.

programme.title: 型男大主厨 Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的.

programme.title: 太平年 Swords Into PlowShares
programme.desc: 太平年描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷钱弘俶赵匡胤郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱秩序崩溃生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，纳土归宋，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ag

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 Warm And Sweet
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情千回百转，南飞与陈放家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 Warm And Sweet
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情千回百转，南飞与陈放家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛.

programme.desc: 曹青胡杏儿与母亲曹曹闭月黄淑仪结伴行医跑江湖，先后认识了患皮肤病的计准吴卓羲和同乡钱通罗仲谦，曹青对钱通一见钟情，千方百计嫁入钱家，可惜醋坊当家钱霜陈炜因与闭月有积怨对曹青百般阻挠，计准因病治愈献计助曹青得偿所愿，曹青入门后以为一劳永逸，谁料钱通深爱丫环山楂岑丽香，曹青乘机搞乱，反令山楂和钱通意外发生关系，钱通纳山楂为妾，令曹青醋意大发，火上加油突然，一具尸骸被发现，闭月被告谋害亲夫判处死刑，钱家怕名声受损，要求曹青与闭月断绝母女关系，此际，曹青竟发现有喜，却惹来一场休妻大行动.

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地 Offliners, The
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融地产商业是贴地举动，富二代王子菲龚嘉欣饰却偏爱离地，与好友许正伟陈智燊饰开设初创科技公司一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希张振朗饰的厉害，邀他加入公司信希是一名离地毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱刘佩玥饰帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤李国麟饰弟王梓龙罗梓龙饰信希之妹丁信恩黄心颖饰身上！.

programme.title: 溏心风暴3 Heart And Greed
programme.desc: 凌丽荧李司棋与丈夫黄永正夏雨凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风黄宗泽更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟李国麟助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华关菊英及亲弟梁赞阮兆祥大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧米雪有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家王浩信与许家独生女许贝儿岑丽香相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱陈敏之与有妇之夫郑立安唐文龙的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文黄翠如关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always and Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP10
programme.desc: Memaparkan Cairyl dan Azhar menyembunyikan diri kerana takut ditangkap polis kerana merogol Lisa, Sara dan Afifah. Mbah Nira mengaku mahu membantu Afifah dan Lisa bagi membalas dendam mereka. Sebaliknya, tiba di rumah Mbah Nira membuat pengakuan kepada polis dia yang membunuh Pak Samad kerana dendamnya 7 tahun lalu, Mbah Nira ditahan polis. Syamil mendapat rakaman video menunjukkan kejadian Lisa dan Afifah di rogol oleh Kumpulan Hunter termasuk membunuh Sara. Afifah dan Lisa kemudiannya menggunakan kuasa ilmu hitam untuk menangkap Cairyl, Azhar dan Bakri. Afifah mahu membunuh kumpulan Hunter tersebut menggunakan ilmu sihirnya, namun Lisa tidak membenarkan. Tiba-tiba, Polis menyerbu dan menahan Lisa dan Afifah selepas mendapat maklumat dari Syamil. Kedua duanya di masukkan dalam penjara.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP2
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Aafiyah kecewa apabila abangnya tidak melayan panggilannya, tambahan pula dia ketakutan dan dalam keadaan trauma. Aafiyah mengalami trauma, dia terpaksa melarikan diri apabila dikejar lelaki misteri dan cuba membunuhnya. Nasib baik Abang Zack muncul dan menyelamatkannya. Aafiyah balik ke rumah setelah sihat. Aafiyah sukakan Zack tetapi bukan sebagi kekasih. Aafiyah sekali lagi menjadi trauma apabila kucing kesayangannya di bunuh. Ini semua angkara Zacky yang menggunakan Rafeeq bagi memuaskan hatinya.

programme.title: Losmen Melati
programme.desc: Seorang bapa yang ingin membalas dendam atas kematian isteri dan anaknya yang terbunuh mengikuti pembunuh, seorang pengutip hutang, kepada losmen pada suatu malam. Dengan pembunuh yang tinggal di bilik sebelah, kali ini hantu berlaku bukan dalam satu bilik tetapi dua. Dalam kejutan yang mengejutkan, di antara harta benda si mati, Golok menjumpai keratan akhbar lama yang menggambarkan sebuah keluarga yang hilang di motel berhantu itu, membayangkan bahawa bukan kebetulan mereka terjumpa Losmen Melati pada malam sebelumnya. Berapa ramai lagi yang tahu tentang rumah tamu terkutuk itu dan apakah masalah masa depan yang akan dibawa oleh ini?

Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

Siapakah yang akan menjuarai DAcademy musim ketujuh?

Mereka meneroka pelbagai tempat menarik dan aktiviti yang mengujakan, sambil berkongsi pengalaman dengan semangat ingin tahu dan keceriaan. Setiap episod membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan yang dipenuhi tawa dan penemuan baharu, sambil menggalakkan kanak-kanak untuk belajar serta mengenali dunia di sekeliling mereka dengan cara yang menyeronokkan dan menarik.

Tidak lama kemudian, Oma Farida ditemui meninggal dunia, menyebabkan cucunya, Raka El Ryan, mula menyiasat kejadian itu. Di sebalik tragedi tersebut, pelbagai rahsia dan kebenaran mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. programme.title: Severe Case Decoded Whats On Today
programme.desc: The program focuses on various serious illnesses, explaining their causes, pathological mechanisms, latest treatment options, and prevention methods in an accessible way. programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. programme.title: Wan Fu Jin An (瓦金安)
programme.desc: Queen Gu Qing played by Wang Yijin is framed and killed in a meticulously planned fire, only to be reborn in the body of Feng Qing played by Fang Jin, a maidservant at the Imperial Garment Bureau. Once a noble queen and now reduced to a lowly palace maid, Feng Qing refuses to be consumed by grief. Determined to protect her younger sister Gu Wan played by Wu Mansi, uncover the truth behind her own murder and bring the real culprit to justice, she chooses to conceal her sharpness and lie low in the depths of the palace under Feng Qings identity. Knowing that she cannot overturn the case on her own, Feng Qing secretly reaches out to her younger brother Gu Xuan played by Chu Zijun, who serves as an imperial physician. With a deep mutual understanding, the siblings form an alliance and use their respective strengths to navigate the power struggles within the harem. While avoiding repeated schemes and traps, they gather clues and outwit the treacherous forces lurking in the palace. As revenge and protection become entwined in this dangerous game, Feng Qing inevitably crosses paths once again with Emperor Xiao Luo played by Zhao Huawei. Xiao Luo has always harbored doubts about Gu Qings tragic death and senses traces of Gu Qing in Feng Qing, prompting him to test her repeatedly. Feng Qing, meanwhile, is filled with complex emotions toward Xiao Luo. Through their repeated confrontations and emotional push-and-pull, the two gradually unravel past misunderstandings, while the bond left unresolved in their previous life quietly begins again. (清女王被王饰演,在一个精心计划的火灾中被杀,但在皇家服装局的女仆金饰演的清的身体中重生.曾经是贵族女王,现在被降低为一个卑的宫务女仆,清拒绝被悲伤吞.决心保护她小姐旺饰演的曼西,揭露自己的谋杀背后的真相,并将真正的罪犯绳之以法,她选择隐藏她的敏度,并躺在宫殿深处,在清身份下.知道她不能独自推翻案件,清清不断地接触了她弟弟,由清饰演的清,作为皇家医生.通过相互理解,两个兄弟在相互之间扮演的情绪,并避免了自己的谋杀,并再次与)

programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace (昆宁宫的历史)
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. programme.desc: Sharon Chan, Samantha Ko, Katy Kung, and Grace Chan are close friends in the entertainment industry. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace (昆宁宫的历史)

However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. programme.title: Wan Fu Jin An Whats On Today ((Wan Fu Jin An 豆瓣电影))
programme.desc: Queen Gu Qing played by Wang Yijin is framed and killed in a meticulously planned fire, only to be reborn in the body of Feng Qing played by Fang Jin, a maidservant at the Imperial Garment Bureau. Once a noble queen and now reduced to a lowly palace maid, Feng Qing refuses to be consumed by grief. Determined to protect her younger sister Gu Wan played by Wu Mansi, uncover the truth behind her own murder and bring the real culprit to justice, she chooses to conceal her sharpness and lie low in the depths of the palace under Feng Qings identity. Knowing that she cannot overturn the case on her own, Feng Qing secretly reaches out to her younger brother Gu Xuan played by Chu Zijun, who serves as an imperial physician. With a deep mutual understanding, the siblings form an alliance and use their respective strengths to navigate the power struggles within the harem. While avoiding repeated schemes and traps, they gather clues and outwit the treacherous forces lurking in the palace. As revenge and protection become entwined in this dangerous game, Feng Qing inevitably crosses paths once again with Emperor Xiao Luo played by Zhao Huawei. Xiao Luo has always harbored doubts about Gu Qings tragic death and senses traces of Gu Qing in Feng Qing, prompting him to test her repeatedly. Feng Qing, meanwhile, is filled with complex emotions toward Xiao Luo. Through their repeated confrontations and emotional push-and-pull, the two gradually unravel past misunderstandings, while the bond left unresolved in their previous life quietly begins again. (清女王被王饰演,在一个精心计划的火灾中被杀,但在皇家服装局的女仆金饰演的清的身体中重生.曾经是贵族女王,现在被降低为一个卑的宫务女仆,清拒绝被悲伤吞.决心保护她小姐旺饰演的曼西,揭露自己的谋杀背后的真相,并将真正的罪犯绳之以法,她选择隐藏她的敏度,并躺在宫殿深处,在清身份下.知道她不能独自推翻案件,清清不断地接触了她弟弟,由清饰演的清,作为皇家医生.通过相互理解,两个兄弟在相互之间扮演的情绪,并避免了自己的谋杀,并再次与)

programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry (2008年,随着金融混乱的海淹没世界,雄心勃勃的企业家霍廷山·库克春· (Ho Tin-Sang Kwok Chun On) 看到机会寻求接管香港最富有的人,春的武功商业帝国,但被另一位商界巨头克凯·普恩干预.他对他的仇恨,桑一直在寻求报复.十年后,现在最富有的克家族被不幸所遮蔽.凯的儿子突然去世是对凯的压倒性打击,他因心脏病发作而昏迷.为了让他们的业务继续前进,他的未经验的年轻女儿克戴,小·,与私人代理人克,克和克,克-克,克)

programme.title: Mrs. RevengeWhats On Today ((Mrs. Revenge豆瓣电影))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (善良的心情的杭萨曼塔科患有某种终结性疾病,因为她只是在丈夫谢凯瓦伊乔纳森的暴政下存在.她发现丈夫和她唯一的朋友普恩苏特曼罗西塔·奎克发生了外遇,在争论时,她被推到道路上,并被车车车悲剧地撞击.然而,杭突然醒来,意识到一切似乎只是一个梦.但随着她的梦中的场景逐渐实现,她认为这是一个预见.为了重写命运,杭决心扭转她的梦中的不幸.杭不仅想摆脱那个丑和她的假朋友,而且还试图把两个人一起来,以便苏特曼能够接管她的不幸.她最终在梦中使用自己的梦想,并逐渐发展了幸福感,她和凯瑟琳一起)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Hipster Tour - South America Sr.2 ((南美潮什么 Sr.2))
programme.desc: In this 10-episode journey across South America, Christy explores three iconic destinationsPeru, Bolivia, and Brazilcombining extreme adrenaline challenges, local culture, and high-energy sightseeing (在这个10集的南美洲旅程中,Christy探索了三个标志性目的地秘鲁,玻利维亚和巴西,)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace (昆宁宫的历史)
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.title: Scam Alert! (骗局警报!)
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers! (报道称,香港每13分钟平均每天损失2500万港元.针对网购,求职,投资,约会应用和电话诈骗的诈骗越来越复杂.公民必须提高他们对诈骗的认识,并保持警,以避免成为受害者!主持人奥昆,爱德文·西乌,李曼-和李曼-豪在现实生活中各种案件中获得更深入的了解,以了解受害者如何被骗.该计划还将以故事形式重现这些场景.专家将承诺将对这些犯罪进行分析,帮助观众识别抢钱的陷,并避免骗局者的目标!)
