programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional car racer, Le falls into despair after causing his brothers death in a car race, until he meets female doctor Hui and becomes an ambulance driver who vows to save lives with speed. Meanwhile, the truth about his brothers accident emerges with the investigation of Les three good friends...

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad-tempered and lives alone. His forced retirement, failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter have left him in despair, prompting him to consider ending his life. Fortunately, he is rescued by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime.

programme.title: All U Need Is Love
programme.desc: Ten major film companies join forces on a comedy-drama film to raise funds and create jobs for industry workers during the COVID-19 pandemic. This film features an all-star ensemble cast starring for free, with the story revolving around a group of hotel guests placed under quarantine in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop (禁止城市警察)
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions! (城的帝国警卫没有武术能力,当皇帝被绑架时,他用他不寻常的爱好拯救了天气:)

programme.title: Turns We Take ((杨龙澄))
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident (东北中国的一个味的热餐厅每天都为不同类型的客户服务.其中包括一个甜蜜的年轻夫妇,两个偏执不良的年轻人和一个出租车司机.)

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In ((九龙城寨之围城))
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the Kowloon Walled City while fleeing, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom. Bonding with Shin, Twelfth Master and AV, they unite under Tornados leadership to defend against the villain, Mr Bigs assaults, and pledge to protect the safe haven of the Walled City together. (少年陈洛克昆在逃跑时意外偶然偶然撞入了科隆城墙,随后在混乱中找到目的,并获得智慧.与辛,十二师和AV结合在一起,他们团结在一起,以防暴风雨的领导,大先生的攻击,并承诺共同保护城墙的安全港口.)

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins ((十月围城))
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Dailys Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army. (1906年10月15日,中国革命领袖孙森返回香港,再次推翻清朝.商人李和中国日报总监陈安排了五名保卫人来保护孙先生 - - 这些都是非常出色的战士,准备好与清杀军进行激烈的战斗.)

programme.title: Cliff Walkers (悬崖步行者)
programme.desc: The first spy thriller movie by famous Director Zhang Yi Mou, this film follows four Communist Party special agents who embark on a secret operation in the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo in 1932. Sold out by a traitor, the agents, who split up into two teams, find themselves surrounded by threats on all sides. Can they complete their mission? (作为著名导演张毛的第一部间惊片,这部电影讲述了共产党四名特工在1932年开始在日本子州的秘密行动.)

programme.title: Its A Wonderful Life (这是一段美妙的生活)
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all. (香港巨头任达库安照顾了他的四代家庭,然而他的三个儿子都面临着自己的挑战.他的女儿回到法国和她的朋友罗伯托一起学习时,一切都发生了变化.罗伯托为任家带来了一波转型,为所有人带来了新的希望和机会.)

programme.title: Kid from the Big Apple 2, The (果2的小伙子,)
programme.desc: Sarah and her mother return to Malaysia to reunite with her retired grandfather. What begins as a warm homecoming turns bittersweet as they notice signs of dementia, with his memories and sense of self fading. As they navigate confusion and emotional strain, the family learns to support one another with patience and love. (萨拉和她的母亲回到马来西亚与退休的祖父再见.开始的热情回家变得苦,因为他们注意到痴呆症的迹象,他的记忆和自我消耗感.)

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain ((造云的山))
programme.desc: When a decade-long tunnel project is about to complete, an earthquake strikes and leads to a series of subsidence and landslides. The tunnel and a nearby town are at stake. A retired soldier and his son step up to try and stop the disasters at source. Will the authority decide to blow up the tunnel to save the 160,000 people in town? (几十年长的道工程即将完成,地震发生,导致一系列的塌和滑坡.道和附近的一个城镇都处于危险之中.一个退休军人和他的儿子站起来试图阻止源头的灾难.当局是否会决定炸毁道,拯救城里16万人?)

programme.title: Inner Senses ((异度空间))
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface. (由于被过去的创伤所带来的反复出现的视觉困扰,求精神科医生吉姆医生恢复她的头脑和克服她的烦的过去.然而,随着逐渐康复,吉姆发现自己被同样的令人不安的图像困扰,因为他的压抑的记忆重新浮出.)

programme.title: Everything Under Control ((超神经械劫案下))
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, one of the security escorts, Jelly, steals the diamonds and flees. Fellow security escorts, Yau Shing and Penguin, are forced to help the robber track down the diamonds. They stumble onto a remote village along the way, encountering strange villagers and mysterious incidents. Can they finally locate Jelly and the diamonds? (在钻石抢劫期间,一个护卫队,杰莉,偷走钻石,逃离.同事护卫队, Shing 和企,被迫帮助抢劫者找到钻石.他们在路上遇到一个偏远的村庄,遇到奇怪的村民和神秘事件.他们终于能找到杰莉和钻石吗?)

programme.title: Detective vs. Sleuths ((神探大战))
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths. Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real Chosen Sleuth instead of a lunatic. (香港被一系列冷血谋杀事件所震撼,受害者是未解决案件的逃跑嫌疑人.这群杀手自称是选中的杀手.前高级侦探李誓言将残忍的杀手绳之以法,证明自己是真正的选中的杀手,而不是疯子.)

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Extended Version (完美结局完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016. (在这部深受喜爱的香港喜剧中,与父母住在一起的三兄弟学会了爱情在培养中勃发展,但在忙,欺骗和自私中被视为理所当然时会枯竭.这部扩展版还包含了2016年农历新年期间原来的剧场上映中遗漏的额外射击场景.)

programme.title: We are Family (我们是家庭)
programme.desc: Struggling as an extra, Chi Kwong joins a rent-a-family company run by Carlos and aspiring actress Catherine, and rent themselves out as make-believe relatives. As they surrogate different families, they unravel the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way. (作为一个额外的家庭成员,奇加入卡洛斯和望女演员凯瑟琳的租公司,并租自己作为假设的亲戚.)

programme.title: Stuntman ((特技替身演员))
programme.desc: Washed-up stunt director Li Sen is offered the role of action choreographer on his director friends final film. Bringing along an ambitious young stuntman, the two generations risk everything to stage a comeback. As Li Sen battles his fierce temper and past mistakes, he also strives to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter. (李森被弃的作导演在导演朋友的最后电影中被提供作战舞蹈演员的角色.带着雄心勃勃的年轻作员,两代冒着一切的风险来舞台上回归. 李森正与他的激烈气质和过去的错误作斗争,他也努力修复与他疏远的女儿的关系.)

programme.title: Good Game ((高手过招))
programme.desc: Facing skyrocketing rent and dwindling customers, a middle-aged internet caf owner assembles a ragtag team for a HK500,000 eSports tournament. He recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a dismissed pro gamer. What follows is an impossible battleone that finally lets these dreamers fight with no regrets. (面对房租升高和客户减少,一个中年网咖啡馆老板为一场500万港元电子竞技比赛组建了一个团队.他招募了他的女儿,一个被洗掉的动作明星和一个被解雇的专业游戏玩家.)

programme.title: The Wig (子)
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a law graduate overwhelmed by despair after failing the bar exam three times and vents his frustration on a drunken passenger one stormy night. Twenty years later, Meng is a successful lawyer, but his investigation into a sexual assault case involving a young girl rekindles haunting memories he cannot escape. (孟是一位法学毕业生,经过三次失败的法律考试,被绝望所淹没,并在一个暴风雨的夜晚对一名醉酒的乘客发出了挫折感.)

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians ((Blades of the 银河护卫队))
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Changan. His charge is the empires most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world. (逃亡的奖励猎人道马在沙漠穿越到南的危险护送任务上.他的指挥是帝国最想要的人,从各方追逐.当竞争对手的部队接近,道马被卷入了一个阴谋,威胁帝国宫廷和军事世界之间的战争.)

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon ((但愿人长久))
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty, and their fathers drug addiction. Initially, the sisters attempt to appease him, but as they enter adolescence, they ultimately rebel and escape. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones. (和她的妹妹面临身份危机,贫困和父亲的毒品成.最初,姐妹试图安抚他,但当他们进入青春期时,他们最终叛乱并逃离.即使他们与父亲分开,也发现他的特征在她亲人中反映.)

programme.title: Ready OR Knot ((不日成婚))
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not? (盖伊和海迪在婚宴上第一次见面以来已经在一起五年了,但婚姻很快就成为了他们关系的挑战.海迪认为婚姻是他们爱的见证,而盖伊认为这是末日.)

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bats knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit

programme.title: Big Times For The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins ((阿牛出獄記))
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature. (这次续集带来了更多的苦的笑容和令人心碎的不幸,)

programme.title: Legend of the Bat ((罗小黑战记))
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place. (传言说,人们只要有钱就能在神秘的蝙蝠岛买到他们想要的东西.)

programme.title: The Story of Sue San ((玉堂春))
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome... (在黄梅歌剧情中,王是一位受尊敬的政府官员的儿子,而苏桑是一名名妓女.虽然他们彼此相爱,似乎是完美的匹配,)

programme.title: Life Gamble ((生死门))
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Taos real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves... (武术师已经退休了几年,但被邀请与另一个师一起战斗四名盗并夺回被盗的龙玉.)

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan ((花木兰))
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity. (穆兰伪装为一名男子士兵,以取代她老年父亲在与野蛮人作战时.她的勇气带来了她在战斗中的胜利,她被晋升为将军.当穆兰带着荣耀回家时,总司令要求她嫁给他的女儿,迫使穆兰透露她的真实身份.)

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2 ((射雕英雄传续集))
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rongs hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat? (知道郭已经通过从英手册学到的功夫赢得了黄荣的婚姻,乌阳捕获黄并同意只要郭能决定手册内容,才释放她.)

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy ((遗产五亿元))
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run. (一位残疾的亿万富翁给他长期失踪的女儿们发出了一封信,邀请她们去日本,希望他能找到一个值得继承的继承人来继承他的巨大的财富.)

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web ((盘丝洞))
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brothers Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang. (在沙夫兄弟的第三部"向西方之旅"中,唐山宗被七个诱惑性蜘蛛灵困在困境中,他们决心通过吃他来实现不朽!)

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3 ((射雕英雄传第三集))
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time? (郭和黄龙去铁棕峰寻找武门书.铁棕的首领发现他们的访问,严重伤害黄.似乎只有南方皇帝杜安才能治愈她,但黄是否会在时间上治愈?)

programme.title: The Younger Generation ((年青的一代))
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four. (故事讲述了一个结婚和五个孩子的年轻女孩. 当她和丈夫去世,)

programme.title: The Villains ((十字追杀令3))
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy? (是一个孤儿,寻求帮助的富有叔叔,她有两个儿子,但只爱上小儿子,一个玩具男孩.贪图的美丽,并强奸她,但当她怀孕时,被错误指控,被叔叔送出去保护.将因他的恶意而受到惩罚吗?)

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl ((山歌恋))
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her fathers towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her fathers debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him... (在这部音乐剧中,一个漂亮的牧羊女,Hsiu Hsiu,爱上了一个漂亮的船员Ta Lung.然而,她不能嫁给他,因为她的父亲从博上借债.)

programme.title: Purple Darts ((紫金镖))
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all. (一个女孩发誓要报复她四名非法犯杀害的父母,她还是一个婴儿.)

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone ((老夫子))
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags! (加入奇幻小说中的蛋先生,他试图赢得一个丽的女人的心. 随着骑行,他的忠实的助手是大土豆先生,一个坚强的家伙,他永远陷入愚蠢的意外.)

programme.title: Killer Clans ((流星蝴蝶剑))
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut. (这部令人兴奋的武士传奇充满了阴谋,权力计划和剑斗争,以产生伟大的动作和引人入胜的戏剧的完美混合.这部电影围绕着两种部落之间的低星世界统治斗争进行了展开.)

programme.title: Dead End ((归去))
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead. (因在车辆崩后遇到了一个富有女孩文.因爱上了文,但文的兄弟不喜欢他,禁止他的妹妹见到他.他羞辱并打,所以拿着他在街上意外发现的枪到文的家,并射杀了她的兄弟.)

programme.title: Four Riders ((四骑士))
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side... (在1950年代韩国战争之后,四名武术专家住在首尔,其中一个人不知为何与毒品贩运集团交叉路口,)

programme.title: Puppy Love ((小狗之爱))
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions. (根据奥斯蒙德的歌曲,这是一段青少年玩失去了无辜的故事.两个最好的朋友一起长大,在刺的过程中遇到两个令人愉快的脏男孩,导致四个男孩情地交换.)

programme.title: The King Boxer ((铁拳))
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly Iron Fist technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory. (志 (Chao Chih Hao) 是一个有前途的武术艺术家,在接受传奇师的训练后离开家,参加一场著名的比赛.然而,当一个腐败的竞争对手学校雇佣日本战士来残疾他时,忍受了残酷的训练,以掌握致命的铁拳技巧,并回来为争取正义和荣耀的激烈,骨碎的战斗.)

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan ((爱奴))
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion. (由于她有火的态度,艾努被绑架并卖给了由强大和无情的春夫人经营的众多人气的四季节妓院.艾努因她的火焰态度而被锁在牢房里.不久,妓院内发生谋杀事件,一名警察必须与时间竞赛,以防止恶意的报复阴谋达到血的结局.)

programme.title: The Happy Trio ((双星伴月))
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiaos fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness... (小,一个被困在城市的村子女孩,与一个善良的流浪汉和一个退休演员结交朋友.他们穷但幸福,尽管小的财富变得更好,当她成为一名歌手.)

programme.title: AXN ULTIMATE CHALLENGE: SARAWAK (们在们的眼前,)
programme.desc: Two Content Creator teams embark on an unforgettable adventure across Sarawak in AXN Ultimate Challenge: Sarawak. Competing in a series of high-energy challenges inspired by the destinations landscapes, culture and traditions, they must rely on skill, endurance and teamwork to outplay their rivals. programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit ((Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly 当幸福来敲门))
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. 세계테마기행
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: 극한직업
programme.desc: 우리 사회에는 상상을 초월하는 극도로 힘든 작업환경 속에서 일하는 사람들이 있다. 이런 극한의 직업에 종사하는 사람들의 삶을 밀착 촬영하여 생생하게 보여줌으로써 역경을 극복하고 살아가고자 하는 사람들의 숭고한 의지와 잃어가고 있는 직업정신의 가치를 되돌아본다.

programme.title: 마샤와 곰

programme.title: 생활의 달인
programme.desc: 수십년간 한 분야에 종사하며 부단한 열정과 노력으로 달인의 경지에 이르게 된 사람들. 삶의 스토리와 리얼리티가 담겨 있는 생활 달인은 그 자체가 다큐멘터리. 비록 소박한 일이지만 평생을 통해 최고가 된 생활 달인의 놀라운 득도의 경지를 만나는 시간.

programme.title: 1박 2일
programme.desc: 우리가 알고 있고, 우리가 알지 못하는 아름다운 우리나라

programme.title: 사장님 귀는 당나귀 귀
programme.desc: 일할 맛 나는 일터를 만들기 위한 대한민국 보스들의 자발적 자아성찰 프로그램

programme.title: 2TV 생생정보
programme.desc: 대한민국 방방곡곡의 유익한 정보와 따뜻한 이야기를 생생하게 전달한다.

programme.title: 다큐멘터리 3일
programme.desc: 3일이라는 단 72시간동안의 특정한 공간을 관찰하고 기록하는 새로운 형식의 다큐멘터리이다. 그 특정한 공간에서 정해진 시간동안 벌어지는 자연스러운 상황변화와 사람들의 일상을 통해서 우리시대를 보고 느낄 수 있다.

programme.title: 무엇이든 물어보세요
programme.desc: 실생활 속 필수아이템에 대한 정확한 지식을 전달 및 시청자참여 중심의 오랜 전통을 이어오고 있는 정통 교양정보 프로그램

programme.title: 한국인의 밥상
programme.desc: 매일 우리는 밥상을 마주한다. 우리의 밥상 속 이야기를 통해 한국인들의 다양한 음식 문화를 보여주고, 식품과 식재료에 대한 영양학적 고찰을 통하여 올바른 정보를 제공하는 프로그램이다.

programme.title: 세계는 지금 스페셜
programme.desc: 세계 곳곳에서 일어나고 있는 사건들을 알기 쉽게 소개해 주는 프로그램

programme.title: 동네 한 바퀴
programme.desc: 동네 한바퀴 돌아볼 여유만 있어도 이 도시는, 삶은, 풍요로워진다. 동네아들 이만기가 걸으며 발견하고, 스토리텔러 나문희의 진정성 있는 목소리로 전하는, 아날로그 도시 기행다큐!

programme.title: 생활의 발견 스페셜
programme.desc: 생활 속에서 직면하게 되는 때로는 간단하기도. 때로는 버겁기도 한 문제들을 해결하기 위한 살림 노하우와 생활정보, 건강, 음식 정보등 실생활에 꼭 필요한 정보들을 소개한다.

programme.title: 동물의 왕국
programme.desc: BBC, 내셔널지오그래픽, NHK, 유럽의 최고 다큐제작사 등 세계 일류의 다큐멘터리 전문 제작사들이 제작한 고급 다큐멘터리들을 엄선하고, 우리말로 더빙하여 정확한 해설로 일반 시청자들에게 소개하여 생태계 이해를 돕는 국내 유일의 동물 전문 다큐멘터리이다.

programme.title: 6시 내고향
programme.desc: 고향을 떠난 도시인들의 각박한 삶에 위안을 주는 동시에 자기 고향에 대한 자긍심을 갖게 하고 다양한 문화를 접할 수 있다. 더불어 살아가는 공동체적 삶의 중요성을 일깨워주고 영농,유통정보 등의 제공으로 농어가 소득증대에 도움을 주고자 노력하고 있는 프로그램이다.

programme.title: 우리말 겨루기
programme.desc: 한글은 세계적으로 과학성을 인정받은 우리의 언어이다! 아름다운 말과 글로 유쾌하고 재미있는 퀴즈 쇼가 펼쳐진다. 우리말의 달인 도전! 우리말 달인 도전자가 우리말 달인에 도전을 하며 운명의 상금이 정해지는 퀴즈 쇼!

programme.title: KBS 뉴스 9
programme.desc: 당일발생 사안을 시청자들에게 신속히 전달하고 관련 현안을 종합 정리해 분석보도.

programme.title: 가요무대
programme.desc: 1985년부터 이어오고 있는 가요무대, 잔잔한 향수와 추억이 담겨있는 전통가요의 무대가 펼쳐진다.

programme.title: 놀면 뭐하니? 스페셜
programme.desc: 수많은 사람을 거치며 카메라에 담긴 의외의 인물들과 다양한 이야기를 담은 프로그램

programme.title: 나 혼자 산다 스페셜
programme.desc: 혼자 사는 스타들의 일상을 관찰 카메라로 보여준다.

programme.title: 전지적 참견 시점 스페셜
programme.desc: 당신의 인생에 참견해드립니다. 가족보다 더 가까운 연예인과 매니저 사이. 매니저의 제보로 스타들의 일상이 공개된다.

programme.title: 오은영 리포트 결혼지옥
programme.desc: 국민 멘토 오은영 박사, 이번엔 부부 솔루션이다! 어느새 남보다 못한 사이가 된 부부들의 일상을 관찰하고 그들이 스튜디오에 직접 출연하여 부부 갈등의 고민을 나누는 리얼 토크멘터리

programme.title: 야구여왕 2
